concept: llama.cpp reasoning-preserve vs Qwen preserve_thinking template key aliasing
summary: 2026-06-28: PR #25105 "jinja, chat: add --reasoning-preserve flag" merged (supersedes #25079), commit b3fed31b.

facts.text: 2026-06-28: PR #25105 "jinja, chat: add --reasoning-preserve flag" merged (supersedes #25079), commit b3fed31b.
2026-07-22: #25999 fixes the reasoning-preserve variable for DS4.
2026-09-16: PR #28987 (StepFun templates honour preserve_thinking) opened and closed unmerged; shows the alias only helps templates that read one of the four names.
Default on: any template that passes the probe gets preserved history unless `--no-reasoning-preserve`.
A template that reads none of the four names (or fails the probe) is unaffected; the flag is a silent no-op.
Qwen3.8 template (line 117) treats `preserve_thinking is undefined` as true, so it preserves even without the flag.
Qwen3.6 template needs `is true`; without the alias it would drop history thinking. With a current build the alias supplies it.
Builds older than b3fed31b (before 2026-06-28) lack the alias: use `--chat-template-kwargs '{"preserve_thinking":true}'`.
`--chat-template-kwargs` containing `preserve_reasoning` logs a deprecation warning but still works.
The #54 complaint is likely from a pre-b3fed31b build, a non-llama.cpp frontend, or templates not matching the probe; unverified.
No runtime test of stock Qwen3.6 GGUF was run here; conclusion rests on source reading.
Whether GGUF-embedded templates differ from the HF chat_template.jinja (Unsloth edits).

Per-request `chat_template_kwargs` is accepted in the request body and merged over server-wide `--chat-template-args` (JSON string), then passed to `tokenizer.apply_chat_template`. Added in PR #829 (2026-02-03). No `--reasoning-preserve` equivalent exists; set `{"preserve_thinking": true}` yourself.

llama.cpp (any build >= 2026-06-28): `llama-server --jinja -m <qwen3.6.gguf>` (preserve is on by default). Explicit: add `--reasoning-preserve`. Verify: `curl localhost:8080/props` shows `chat_template_caps.supports_preserve_reasoning: true`.
Belt and braces / older builds: add `--chat-template-kwargs '{"preserve_thinking":true}'`.
mlx_lm.server: `mlx_lm.server --model <m> --chat-template-args '{"preserve_thinking":true}'`, or per request `"chat_template_kwargs":{"preserve_thinking":true}`.
arg.cpp sets default_template_kwargs["preserve_reasoning"]="true" when the user did not specify it
`--reasoning-preserve` / `--no-reasoning-preserve` write "true"/"false" to preserve_reasoning, env LLAMA_ARG_REASONING_PRESERVE, for server, completion and cli
chat.cpp calls jinja::caps_apply_preserve_reasoning when the input has a boolean preserve_reasoning
caps_apply_preserve_reasoning sets preserve_thinking=enabled and clear_thinking, truncate_history_thinking, drop_thinking=!enabled
supports_preserve_reasoning is detected by rendering a history whose non-latest assistant turn carries a reasoning placeholder and checking it appears in output
global_from_json runs after caps_apply_preserve_reasoning, so an explicit preserve_thinking in kwargs overrides the alias
Qwen3.6-27B chat_template.jinja line 101 gates historical think blocks on `preserve_thinking is defined and preserve_thinking is true`
Qwen3.8-27B template line 117 preserves when `preserve_thinking is undefined`, so default is preserve
PR #25105 "jinja, chat: add --reasoning-preserve flag" merged 2026-06-28
caps.cpp history lists the flag commit b3fed31b on 2026-06-28 and a DS4 variable fix on 2026-07-22
PR #28987 (StepFun templates honour preserve_thinking) was closed unmerged
mlx_lm.server merges request chat_template_kwargs over server chat_template_args and passes them to apply_chat_template
mlx_lm.server defines `--chat-template-args` as a JSON string for apply_chat_template
mlx-lm added server chat_template_kwargs support in PR #829 on 2026-02-03
Stock Qwen3.6 GGUFs get preserved thinking from the generic flag on builds from 2026-06-28 onward (inferred from source, not run)
mlx_lm.server has no generic preserve flag; users must pass preserve_thinking explicitly

Existing dossier and froggeric #54 commenters: the two keys are unaliased, stock Qwen ignores the generic flag. Source code: llama.cpp aliases them internally (caps_apply_preserve_reasoning). CONTRADICTS: qwen3-6-preserve-thinking-chat-template-flag-and-prompt-cache-reuse.md (claim that "a template that does not alias the two will not see the generic flag" and the open question "no source tested").
